dict.string: Come Back One Day uses the microphone to record voice notes about the places you save and audio clips attached to journal entries.
Come Back One Day uses Face ID to keep your journal entries private.
Come Back One Day looks for recent photo moments in your library to suggest as journal entries.
Come Back One Day looks for your Health data to avoid duplicating mood entries.
Come Back One Day uses your journal mood tags to update your State of Mind in Health.
